result.summary: Found several visual issues: duplicate restaurant cards, truncated names, and overlapping UI badges on food images.

issues.description: The first two cards under 'Fastest near you' show identical images, names ('Green Bowl Poké'), delivery times, and fees, appearing as unintended duplicates.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel loads unique nearby restaurants and does not repeat the same listing twice in a row.

issues.description: The third restaurant name is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full name, cutting off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with a full accessible name so the restaurant name is fully readable.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges (e.g. '15–25 min') sit over the food photos and partially obscure the dish imagery.
issues.suggestion: Reposition badges to a corner with better contrast/padding, or place time info below the image so photos remain unobstructed.

issues.description: Category filter chips after 'All' use very light gray text/background, giving weak visual hierarchy and low emphasis compared to the selected chip.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast for unselected chip labels and borders so categories remain easy to scan.
